name: @aliasmode/anyfetch
stderr:
Free web search and fetch for AI agents

Usage: anyfetch <COMMAND>

Commands:
  mcp     Serve the web tools over stdio MCP
  setup   Connect Anyfetch to the agent harnesses on this machine
  search  Search without an API key. The default provider asks Brave, Yahoo and DuckDuckGo at once
  fetch   Fetch one or more pages and extract their readable content
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
